filter_definition.F1: +2 no independent-group supportive experiment in corpus
filter_definition.F2: +1 per in-window Comment/Reply/Response or null-result experiment, max +2
filter_definition.F3: +3 original or supportive record withdrawn/retracted (arXiv comment)
filter_definition.F4: +1 single-sample / filamentary / onset-only / small-fraction language in original abstract
filter_definition.F5: +1 original lacks DOI/journal-ref/'accepted' note > 12 months after posting; -1 if linked to a peer-reviewed venue
filter_definition.F6: +1 positive follow-ups exist and all share an author with the original group
filter_definition.F7: +1 in-window critical records outnumber supportive ones (added this iteration)
filter_definition.same_group: shares >= 1 author (first initial + surname) with original_group
filter_definition.distinct_groups: distinct last authors; original-group papers merged into one

claims.name: RuO2 as a bulk room-temperature altermagnet
claims.claim: Bulk rutile RuO2 is a collinear (d-wave) altermagnet with room-temperature Neel order and non-relativistic spin-split bands (crystal Hall effect).
claims.status_note: Every in-window bulk-crystal measurement (neutron, muSR-era follow-ups, NMR, quantum oscillations, ARPES, Mossbauer, resonant diffraction) is null; the surviving debate is about strained thin films (next claim).

F1_no_independent_replication.evidence: no supportive experiment from outside the original group in the corpus

F2_comment_reply_null.evidence: 12 Comment/Reply/null records, e.g. arXiv:2410.05850, arXiv:2412.12258, arXiv:2501.10649, arXiv:2503.20621, arXiv:2504.21138

F3_withdrawn_retracted.evidence: no withdrawal/retraction note on original or supportive records

F4_weak_evidence_language.evidence: no weak-evidence phrase in original abstract(s)
